code.why: The descriptor's credentialDoor (resend/src/manifest.ts credentialDoor): the World's runtime calls it at every boot for the key the World's application holds as RESEND_API_KEY. The life's applications and the published examples hold keys made on the API Keys page and boot no application; the customer entry (journeys/first-use.json) is the application that holds it.
The host process around the fetch: a World's host serves the pack's fetch on a port; the life and the published examples walk that fetch in process.
